native_observations.photographs: Legacy, corrected and whole-context outputs all retain visible grain and soft fine detail. Cyclist fabric/arm detail remains well short of exact GT; roof ornament remains soft. At native scale there is no convincing visible quality improvement from this geometry correction.
native_observations.GFX_original_four: Sky and building retain grain. Foliage stays soft and chain-link mesh remains uneven; the old/new grid views appear extremely similar. These internal ROIs do not cover the changed last tile row/column.
native_observations.GFX_edges: Right-edge beams/windows and bottom shadow show no obvious visual regression or improvement between old/new at the selected160px scale. Both retain visible noise, especially the bottom shadow. This does not establish invisibility of all full-frame differences.
native_observations.reference: DSCF3880 is a separate ISO100 f/5.6 capture with different aperture, exposure and moving subjects, never exact GT or a pixelwise scoring target.
